name: qa-desktop-agent
description: Local desktop agent for launching Chrome with QA profiles
author: QA Team

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/server/origin.test.js dist/browser/validateProfile.test.js dist/browser/launchProfile.headers.test.js
scripts.prepare:release: npm run icons && npm run prepare:browsers && npm run build
scripts.prepare:release:mac: npm run icons && npm run build
scripts.package:mac: npm run prepare:release:mac && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:release && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
